sentences.text: This black marlin's track begins on {first_date} and runs for {days_tracked}, {species_rank_days}.
Black marlin live in warm waters of the Indian and Pacific oceans and are among the largest bony fish.
By {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began, {species_rank_distance}.
Its whole track lies south of the equator, between {northernmost_lat} and {southernmost_lat}.
